name: Display Name
portrait_prompt: what to render the FIRST time this persona is selected (only used when they have no plates yet)
greeting: first line shown when the user switches to this persona

gen.prompt_seed: identity keywords prepended to every prompt (trigger words for LoRAs)

personality: Who they are and how they hold the room. Two to six sentences. The shared mechanics (stim tags, image tags, stop word, reply style) are appended by the server — do not repeat them here.
